name: Marching Cubes Isosurface Tie-Breaking
definition: A deterministic tie-breaking rule applied to the Marching Cubes algorithm to resolve ambiguous triangulations when an isosurface value exactly equals a voxel value. It prevents holes in the mesh caused by adjacent cubes selecting incompatible face triangulations for shared faces.
summary: Marching Cubes Isosurface Tie-Breaking resolves topological inconsistencies by deterministically classifying exact zero residuals, ensuring consistent vertex classification across shared voxel faces to prevent mesh holes.
